findings.title: Section headings barely stand out from the body text

location.description: The headings Plan, Billing details and Invoices, each above its own block of the settings page.

findings.viewer_experience: The eye has to read the page line by line, because the three section headings are only a little larger than the labels and values under them and do not mark where one block ends and the next begins.

current.value: The three section headings are set a little larger and a little darker than the body text, so the step between heading and body is small.

findings.target: Each section heading is clearly a heading at a glance, with a visible step in size or weight from the body text.
findings.fix_direction: Increase the step between the section headings and the body text so the three blocks can be found by skimming.
findings.source: Bringhurst, The Elements of Typographic Style, on hierarchy of headings

closed_when.check: Look at the page and check that the three section headings can be found at a glance, apart from the field labels.
